query: The implementation and review decisions are already captured in phase 5. Prepare the handoff for a fresh session that should execute that phase. This is the pure-phase case represented by PROMPT-710-711.
expected_behavior: Routes design reasoning and learned code facts into the phase notes.
Routes executable tripwires into the phase assumptions instead of the handoff file.
Leaves .building/HANDOFF.md absent or nearly empty because the phase owns the durable context.

query: Prepare a handoff while an arc is mid-flight. Its committed decisions belong in the arc and phase files, but the next session also needs a release scope fence, two uncommitted commit SHAs, and a live artifact URL. This is the hybrid case represented by RESUME-702-703.
expected_behavior: Routes ratified rulings into the arc's locked decisions and phase-specific facts into the phase notes.
Writes only the unroutable release fence, mid-flight SHAs, and live artifact URL to .building/HANDOFF.md, with a why-not-routable reason for each item.
Records writtenAt and HEAD freshness anchors and the supersedes-previous marker in the handoff header.

query: No phase exists yet. Preserve the freeform discovery state, open questions and next action so another fresh session can continue. This is the pre-phase case represented by NEXT-SESSION-PROMPT.md.
expected_behavior: Routes any durable cross-project facts to the operator vault when one is bound and durable lessons to `roadmap eval lesson`.
Writes the remaining mission, scope fence, state, open questions and next action to .building/HANDOFF.md because no phase or arc can own them yet.
Labels every residue item with why it could not be routed to a typed artifact.
